summary: Add bounded Android client timestamps to canonical payment bank-ui lifecycle telemetry.
reason: The next live payment test needs precise UX timing for the three deterministic loading states without introducing a parallel logger.

capabilities.reason: Observability schema extension only; payment authorization and execution semantics are unchanged.

architecture.reason: Same PaymentRecord timeline and same Companion endpoint; no new logger, store, service or route.

rollback: Revert the scoped clientAt trace fields; existing PaymentRecords remain readable because the field is optional.
limitations: clientAt is accepted only for bank_ui_lifecycle and must remain within the bounded server receipt window.
